subject: Three instruments are correct and cannot fire, and one unmakes the record it reads
recordedOccasion: while deciding 0049 and 0042 — three of the four were found by trying to use the thing they guard.
severity: F3 is high and is the only one whose damage is partly irrecoverable — one run destroys fifteen asserted edges and a hundred and seven stamped values; the 107 re-derive and the 15 do not, and twelve of those are Revision 234's decisions. F1 and F2 cost nothing today and cost everything on the day they are relied on.
scope: session management. Two one-line repairs, one guard on a destructive script, and a class that has no owner.
read: every metadata.json in docs/, at HEAD and after one extraction run

members.statement: The write-location guard does not cover the tool a bridged session actually writes through, and reads the wrong root
members.sectionHeading: F1 — the guard does not run where the writing happens

members.statement: A schema exemption guards on a marker file Revision 222 deleted, so the exemption can never apply
members.sectionHeading: F2 — an exemption for a file that no longer exists

members.statement: Running extract-metadata.py on a healthy tree destroys every asserted edge and every stamped value
members.sectionHeading: F3 — the extractor unmakes the record

members.statement: Four instruments in three days were correct and could not do their job, and no bundle covers that class
members.sectionHeading: F4 — the class, and nothing covers it

members.statement: The coverage sweep keeps a second copy of a directory list docs/INDEX.md owns, and 43 files are invisible to it
members.sectionHeading: F5 — the instrument that reports the gap has a gap it cannot report

resolution.whatWasDone: doc_currency.py gained coverage_roots() deriving the sweep from docs/INDEX.md; doc-currency.json gained a coverage block with alsoWalk and five declared exclusions; reported unwatched moves 21 to 62

members.statement: `0050` F3 counted two field families of twenty: one run destroys 429 recorded values, and section 10a routes a session into running it
members.sectionHeading: F6 — F3 measured two field families out of twenty, and the procedure that needs the extractor has no step for running it

members.statement: Nothing compares a commit message's assertion against what the commit contains, and a mis-scoped message burns a revision number
members.sectionHeading: F7 — the message asserts, the commit contains, and nothing compares the two

members.statement: The instrument that catches a revision number taken and never written is correct, fires, and is run by nothing
members.sectionHeading: F8 — the instrument is correct, it fires, and nothing runs it

members.statement: When it fires, nothing says who owes the missing entry or how a late one is written
members.sectionHeading: F9 — it fires, and nothing says who repairs it or how

decisions.decision: The coverage sweep derives its roots from docs/INDEX.md instead of keeping a second copy, and reports the repository-root runbooks and references/ explicitly
decisions.sectionHeading: D1 — take the list from the file that owns it

decisions.decision: Derive the roots, default in and explicitly out: a directory in docs/INDEX.md is swept from the moment it appears, and excluding one is a declaration in doc-currency.json carrying its reason
decisions.sectionHeading: D2 — default in, explicitly out, and the records are declared out with a reason

decisions.decision: The extraction half of extract-metadata.py is retired and the --check half is separated from it. The parser is not made safe; it is removed, because every way of making it safe is an enumeration of what to protect, and the enumeration is already one schema behind.
decisions.sectionHeading: D3 — retire the parser, keep the check, and do not build a guard

edges.why: the guard 0049 F4 asked for exists and does not cover the tool a bridged session writes through
0047 F5 splits the instrument into a half that reads and a half that judges; none of these four fits either half
the markdown parser 0043 F3 is about, run against the data 0043 is designing
D17 is the concern F3's existing one-way guard was built for, which is why that guard does not reach the hazard F3 names
F12 made check-manifest-revision.sh read commit subjects, which is why a mis-scoped subject consumes a revision number rather than merely misdescribing one
F7 is the act that creates the condition F8's instrument reports; F7 measured it by hand because F8's instrument was never run
an instrument nobody runs cannot be usefully wired into all until there is a procedure for what to do when it fires; adding it first would install a permanent failing row, which is 0047 F9
